consistency_note: No train footage, so no journey look exists. The landmark set is ALL drone aerials (no street-level, no gimbal walk), which is at least internally consistent in camera style. Light splits three ways: (1) clear/hazy summer daytime - 11652280+11567873 (same shoot, flat blue sky), 13326452, 16023860, 19909893: ~220 s that would cut together acceptably as a sunny summer day, though sky texture differs (cloudless vs altocumulus vs haze); (2) golden hour/sunset - 18420377 and the sunrise 13326487, ~48 s; (3) overcast hyperlapse 13299240, which matches nothing in speed or light. Vertical Cristo clips are a separate backlit pair.
sourcing_note: Landmarks are easy; trains do not exist in what was reachable. 10 pexels.com-restricted searches (VLT tram, train window, Santa Teresa bondinho, Corcovado train, metro/subway, Lapa arches/light rail, Portuguese terms bonde/VLT/trem/metro Rio, plus Christ/Sugarloaf/Copacabana) returned zero Pexels VIDEO pages of the Rio VLT, Santa Teresa tram, Corcovado rack railway, MetroRio or SuperVia. Rio rail appears only as /photo/ pages (tram on the Carioca Aqueduct, modern VLT downtown in a collection). The tram/train videos the search engine offered instead were downloaded and viewed: Mexico City tourist trolley, Porto, a European heritage tram, a US streetcar, an Indian loco, a model in an anonymous subway; plus six generic train clips viewed under sydney/ that are also not Rio. Queries that work: "Christ the Redeemer drone", "Copacabana", "Rio de Janeiro aerial", "Sugarloaf" - Pexels lists thousands and nearly all are 4K drone. Limits: only 10 landmark clips were taken by instruction, so the landmark total is a floor, not a ceiling; the true landmark supply is far larger. 2 of 19 fetches unresolved. Sugarloaf cable car footage was not sought (not a train). The repo sheet.sh failed on every clip with ffmpeg 6.1 (pad filter error); sheets were made with an equivalent scratchpad script and are in work/audit/rio/sheet_1..3.jpg. Steadiness judged from 4 stills per clip, not playback.
